description:
With Stream Deck, unleash your creative genius and make waves across Twitch and YouTube. All while focusing on what matters most your audience. As a broadcaster that likes to produce on the fly and have high quality production.


What's new in Stream Deck 7.6?

🎛️ Infobar Actions for Stream Deck Neo
The Infobar is now a place you can put things. Drag an action onto it the way you would onto a key, and it shows live information while you work.
- See what’s playing on Spotify without touching your phone.
- See your CPU and GPU stats without opening another app with SimpleStats.
- Know the moment your AI agent needs you, even when you're looking at another screen, with ChatGPT & Codex.
- See today’s forecast and air quality before you head out the door with Weather.
Building your own plugin? SDK 3.0 now lets Makers add Infobar support for Stream Deck Neo. See the SDK docs for details.

🎵 All-New Spotify Plugin
The Spotify plugin has been rebuilt on Spotify’s official Web API. You get new actions for your library, playlists, search, and queue, plus a Now Playing view on the Stream Deck Neo Infobar.
Get Spotify
All of the new actions built on Spotify’s Web API require signing in with a Spotify Premium account.

🤖 ChatGPT & Codex Plugin
A new plugin brings OpenAI’s ChatGPT desktop app to Stream Deck, turning it into a dedicated physical surface for your agent. Send prompts, switch models, and run skills from a key or dial, and the Neo Infobar shows what your agent is doing so you always know the moment it needs you.
Get ChatGPT & Codex

🛠️ Improvements & bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where the app did not always start when set to launch automatically.
- (Windows) Fixed an issue, introduced in version 7.5.1, where some items like images could not be dragged from File Explorer into the app and some plugins could not interact with the app.
- The background library now includes backgrounds sized for the Stream Deck Neo Infobar.
- The Website action now updates its icon whenever the URL changes.
- Fixed an issue where Stream Deck Network Dock could disconnect at random.
- (macOS) Fixed an issue where clicking the menu bar item could crash the app on macOS 27.
- (Windows) Fixed an error message that appeared in the installer when fully uninstalling the app.
- (Windows) Reduced a periodic spike in system load caused by the scan for installed applications.
